what_it_does: This paper solves the mismatch between sparse matrix data (matrices where most values are zero) and specialized GPU hardware accelerators designed for matrix multiplication. Sparse Tensor Cores on GPUs demand that zeros appear in strict patterns (every other element or 1-out-of-2 zeros), but real scientific data has zeros scattered randomly. The work reformats random sparsity patterns into the structured patterns that hardware accelerators demand, enabling efficient computation on GPUs.
